notes: The complete original catalog, source lock and original source material are retained. The archive commit, rather than a potentially stale upstream version string, identifies this resource.
Generate into a fresh directory and retain the seed, generator identity, options, compiler flags and output. Seed reproducibility is qualified for the selected binary on this declared platform.
Package checks compare the same GCC compiler at O0 and O2. This is useful differential agreement, not an independent reference compiler or a proof that every random program is correct.
Native source and binary profiles are exercised on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64; no OCI, other ABI/OS, full compiler campaign or official benchmark score is claimed.
CMake/Ninja are build-only dependencies. Exact private tool bindings are supported by the maintainer replay without modifying APT/dpkg.
Assertions are enabled. All upstream source files remain unmodified in share/yarpgen-scalar/source; the build uses an independent copy.
The scalar and loop branches are separately pinned resources. They install into separate package prefixes even though both expose bin/yarpgen.
Git discovery is disabled for archive builds. Build metadata uses SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0; the exact upstream commit is recorded by the resource definition.

The original run_gen.py campaign scripts and test configurations remain available in the source directory. Campaign orchestration and optional SDE, ISPC, SYCL or MSVC are not exercised by this package qualification.
